name: Kozuka Akira
source: A young man who loves Shotaro. Sometimes a bit too scary. Suddenly disappears every time the hero siren can be heard. Looks like a straightforward and nice young man, but is actually full of mystery. His occupation is a manga artist and his dream is to buy his own home.
